suggested_experiment_name: WD-IFMR (White Dwarf Initial-Final Mass Relation ALP bound)
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1, as plotted on the y-axis
notes: Stellar/astrophysical bound (not DM haloscope) on ALP-photon coupling g_agamma for keV-MeV mass ALPs, derived from the white dwarf initial-final mass relation (WD-IFMR) applied to AGB stars. Constrains part of the 'cosmological triangle' near ma~1 MeV, gaγγ~1e-5 GeV^-1. Coupling type is AxionPhoton (ALPs coupling exclusively to photons, La = -gaγγ/4 F F~ a). Data points are approximate readings of the lower boundary of the WD-IFMR exclusion curve in Figs 1/15 combined with text values (10 keV excluded at 0.794e-10, 316 keV region ~3.16e-9, 630 keV reaching into triangle at 1e-5). Bound relaxes at high gaγγ due to ALP decay inside the burning shell. 95% CL. No DM density since this is a stellar energy-loss bound. | selector: figure_vision over text (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 0, 0.5, 30)) | Vision: Figure 1 shows ALP-photon constraints (g_agamma [GeV^-1] vs m_a [keV], log-log). The derived constraint of this work is the green 'WD-IFMR' region. X-axis 1 keV (1e3 eV) to ~2.5 MeV; Y-axis 1e-10 to 1e-3 GeV^-1. The lower boundary is near the plot floor (~1e-10) for masses 1-100 keV (extends below plot range at low mass), then rises steeply above ~130 keV forming the right side of the wedge toward the cosmological triangle (~g~1e-5, m~1 MeV). Boundary overlaps with HB Stars, SN1987, and SN1987A(a->gamma gamma) regions, making the exact green edge difficult to read; coordinates are approximate. Stellar/astrophysical constraint, so no DM density assumed. 95% CL per caption. | Calibration: No calibration needed
